evidence.reason: Added a `except ValueError` handler to the FIXED verification block in harvest that applies the identical terminal-failure sequence (FAILED verdict, record state failed, item state per kind, save_queue before mark_finding_outcome, break) so deterministic verify/mechanical ValueErrors like duplicate claimed commits no longer leave the run queued to retry every tick, while git failures from make_worktree outside the try still propagate; tests were not run (harness denies non-git commands, CI is the authority).
